title: Friedgut junta approximation
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and let $\varepsilon>0$. There exist a coordinate set $J$ and a Boolean function $g$ such that $|J|\le 1+I(f)^3\varepsilon^{-2}9^{d}$, where $I(f)$ is the total influence of $f$ and $d$ is its Friedgut degree at parameter $\varepsilon$. The Fourier weight of $f$ outside the frequencies $S\subseteq J$ with $|S|\le d$ is at most $2\varepsilon$; moreover, $g$ depends on at most $|J|$ coordinates and has relative Hamming distance at most $\varepsilon$ from $f$.
